text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After El Condor Pasa's amazing
performance at the tryouts...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's been training with new trainers
every
day, going through their
proposed training
programs.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, who wants to present me with their
training program today?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll do any exercise, no matter how tough!
Be strict! Show no mercy!
I'm lookin'
forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text: Finally! Today's my turn, El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Sprint one lap, then jog the next! Then
repeat this one hundred times!
It's the
same program the world champion does!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the world champion?! Then it's
good, great, perfect for me!
Let's get to it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That day, El Condor Pasa, who hasn't even
debuted yet, does the
same training that
the world champion does...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
At last, today is my turn! You see, I've
been working with a certain university lab
that works on developing cutting-edge
training
equipment.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
And from that lab came this training cast!
It's a brilliant device that
puts twenty
times your normal weight on your body!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Cutting-edge? Twenty times?
Brilliant?! I don't really get it,
but it
sounds cool! Let's get to it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Another day, El Condor Pasa covers her
entire body in a mysterious
training cast...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
What does one need to take on the
world?! It's passion! Zeal! An
unbreakable
will! Come, let us yell unto the horizon,
El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! I like your passion! Understood!
I'll give it a go!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I am the one! The only! The indomitable
fighter! The lightspeed
storm! The
strongest in the world—El Condor
Pasaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This time,
she's yelling at the setting sun
until her throat goes dry. No matter the
training, she seems to takes it all in
stride...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until one day, I spot El Condor Pasa
walking with a slight wobble in
her gait.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Sleepy... Spinning... I'm...
dizzy...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay? El, aren't you overworking
yourself recently?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmngh? Not... at all. I'm fine,
fit as a fid—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh man, I'm so sorry! My legs wobbled for
a second there.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec! You're...
the line cutter! What a
coincidence!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, nothing to worry about at all! As
you can see, I'm an
energetic, motivated,
and unparalleled condor—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
O-ow! G-Grass?! That was way too
pinpoint to be an accident!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Gosh... My apologies. Are you hurt
anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As of late, El has been undergoing rough
training with a new trainer
every day, so it
appears she is quite spent.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
W-w-whoa, Grass-Grass-Grass?! I can't
pretend like I didn't hear that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm always telling you, aren't I? That I'm
the world's strongest racer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The condor soars the skies so that one day it may carve its name in the annals of history! That's its future—my future!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So I can't! Stop! Now! No way am I gonna
complain when I'm just
getting started!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are, El! I've come up with a
program for you! Please
train with me
today!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Look!
Another potential partner is here for
me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I bid you adios! Grass, see
you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El, wait a—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Before that, I almost forgot! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You must be reeeally taking your time with
my program... Isn't that
right? I totally get
it! ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm eagerly waiting for your training
program! Anyways, this time for
real. Chao!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
She said her fill and then immediately
left. Same as usual, I
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And today, just like always, she'll spend
the day with a new trainer
aiming to be the
world's strongest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It might be more accurate to say she
is stubborn... But I suppose
so.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
She sets huge goals for herself without
any fear, and she'll do
anything to make those
goals reality.
I respect that part about her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However... I believe even that side of her
can become detrimental at
times.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes... At the very least,
by working with a
new trainer every day, her
fatigue from the
previous day is not being taken into
consideration.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, her fatigue has only continued
to build up.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...If things get dangerous,
I won't hesitate
to stop her by force. After
all, she is not
the type of person to stop after a mild
scolding.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Which reminds me, are you not also trying
to scout El yourself?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It may be impertinent of me, but I implore
you to give what I have
told you some
thought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even without Grass Wonder's advice, it's
clear that El Condor Pasa
has a strong will
and an even stronger desire to train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a trainer, what can I do to help make
her dreams come true?
